restoration_note: Teaching describes the Lord going forth in four faces (First Man, Third Ambassador, Jesus the Radiance, Great Counsel) against which the self organizes four counterparts (King of Darkness, evil counsel, desire, law of Sin and Death). Each face/counterpart receives the same formulaic articulation: identification + tree (perception) + soul/spirit + stature (body) + sons/powers. Most short-trace gaps are morphological completions across line breaks and accept the editor's proposals with high confidence. The First Man section (lines 5-12) and the second-counterpart section (lines 22-28) suffer extensive lacunae in their middle clauses, which I mark unrestorable rather than invent. The Great Counsel section (the most theologically articulated of the four faces) is best preserved and yields the densest set of confident restorations: cosmos-within-him, end of dissolution, Andrias-statue, wreath, five elements, great fire of consummation, perfection-in-works, end of times.

coptic_restorations.basis: Editor: ⲙ̄[ⲡⲟⲩ]ⲁⲓ̈ⲛⲉ — 'from the Light,' continued by ⲁⲓ̈ⲛⲉ at start of next line. The four faces of the light proceed from the Light itself toward the soul.
Editor: ⲁⲩⲧⲛ̄ⲛⲁ[ⲩϩ] = Lycopolitan ⲁⲩⲧⲛ̄ⲛⲁⲩϥ 'they sent him' — verbal completion across line break.
Editor: partial traces ⲙⲡⲕⲉⲕⲉ preserved. The five storehouses are guarded against the darkness; the First Man comes upon the storehouses 'of the Darkness' to seize the Enmity.
3-character lacuna with no preserved traces; could be ⲧⲏⲣⲥ̄ ('all of it') or a connecting particle, but unconstrained.
7-character lacuna at start of formulaic clause; cannot be fixed from parallels.
12-character lacuna closing the 'his tree' clause for First Man; the predicate of his tree is uncertain (parallel sections give different content for each face).
6-character lacuna preceding ⲁⲃⲁⲗ ⲁϫⲛ̄; verb of motion required but not constrained.
3-character lacuna at end of clause; no traces.
6-character lacuna at start of section before ⲡⲉϩⲭⲁⲓ ⲡⲉ formula.
Editor: ⲡⲕⲁ[ⲍ ⲙ̄ⲡⲕⲉⲕⲉ] 'land of the Darkness' — the standard cosmic identification of the sea (natural perception in mass) with the territory under the self's rule.
10-character lacuna at start of section; no parallel constraint.
8-character lacuna closing ⲡⲉϩϣⲛⲉ ⲡ- formula.
Editor: standard formula 'The second face is the [third]'; ⲡⲙⲁⲍ continues into ϣⲁⲙⲧ at start of next line. The teaching's titulary paradox: the second face is the Third Ambassador.
Editor: ⲧⲉϩⲍⲓⲕⲱⲛ [ⲛⲟⲩⲁⲓ̈]ⲛⲉ 'his image of light' — completed by ⲛⲉ at start of next section.
Editor: ⲉⲧⲙ̄ⲡⲥⲁⲙ[ⲡ]ⲧⲛⲉ 'on the lower side' — standard Manichaean spatial idiom for the deepest place of the natural mind, where the Third Ambassador's image is revealed.
Editor: ⲧⲏⲣ[ⲟⲩ ⲉϩⲧⲏⲕ] ⲁⲣⲉⲧϩ̄ 'all, standing fixed within them' — the light bound in the soul's works, awaiting recognition.
Editor: [ⲁ]ⲣⲉⲧϩ̄ 'standing' — verbal noun completing the phrase from the previous line.
5-character slot before ⲙ̄ⲡⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ; the formula 'his stature/ship is X of all the cosmos' parallels section 238 (ⲡⲉϩⲭⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ … ⲡⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ). ⲡⲉϩⲭⲁⲓ̈ = his ship/stature.
Editor: [ⲡⲉϩ]ϫⲁⲓ̈ — possessive prefix 'his' continued onto next line as ϫⲁⲓ̈ 'ship.'
5-character qualifier on 'stature of light' before ⲡⲉ ⲡⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ; ⲧⲏⲣϥ̄ ('entire/all of him') fits the cosmos-as-stature identification: 'his entire stature of light is the cosmos.'
3-character lacuna at end of cosmos clause; could be ⲇⲉ or ⲧⲏⲣϥ̄ but unconstrained.
Editor: ⲡⲉϩϣ[ⲛⲉ] 'in his tree' — completed across line break.
Editor: ⲉⲧⲟⲓ ⲛ̄[ⲉⲁⲩ] 'which is in glory' — standard Coptic adjectival construction with ⲉⲁⲩ.
Editor: standard formulaic introduction 'Jesus the Radiance, who has come forth from the Greatness'; continues to ⲛⲁⲟ at start of next line. Lexicon: ⲓⲏⲥ ⲡⲡⲣ̄ⲓ̈ⲉ.
6-character lacuna; ⲡⲱⲛ[ⲍ] completes 'life,' followed by participial 'and drawing/raising them' to fit ⲙ̄ⲙⲁϩ ⲁⲡⲭⲓⲥⲉ 'them to the Height' in next line. Reading: 'sends light and life and raises them.'
5-character qualifier on ⲧⲉϩⲥⲟⲫⲓⲁ; ⲧⲏⲣⲥ̄ ('entire,' fem.) fits parallel formula 'his Wisdom entire of light.'
Editor: ⲛ̄ⲟⲩⲁⲓ̈[ⲛⲉ] 'of light' completed across line break.
Editor: [ⲧ]ⲉⲧϩⲟⲱⲣ — feminine relative converter referring back to ⲥⲟⲫⲓⲁ.
2-character completion after partial ⲡϣ; ⲡϣ[ⲏⲛ] 'the tree' fits — souls are sent to the tree of wisdom (a tree of light, paralleling each face's tree). Alternative ⲡϣⲓⲣⲉ less likely.
Editor: [ⲧ]ⲡⲗⲁⲛⲏ — feminine article restored before Greek loanword.
Editor: ⲛ̄ⲧ[ⲉ ⲡⲛⲁⲃⲉ] 'of Sin' — natural completion of the doublet 'Error of the cosmos / law of Sin' (cf. section 285's parallel 'law of Sin and Death').
Editor: [ⲉⲧ]ⲭⲏⲩ 'which lie' — relative pronoun.
6-character lacuna in middle of clause about souls suffering within him; not constrained.
Editor: ϩⲟⲱⲣ[ⲟ] = 'send forth' completed across line break.
8-character lacuna; reading says souls 'become illumined through his Wisdom of light.' ⲉⲩⲣ̄ⲡⲣⲓⲉ = 'who shine/are illumined' (from ⲡⲣⲓ̈ⲉ, lexicon stem) fits the spiritual sense.
Editor: [ⲁⲣ]ⲁⲩ — directional preposition 'unto them' completing across line break.
10-character lacuna giving the Great Counsel's first action; no traces.
16-character lacuna following the encompassing-circuit formula; not constrained.
Editor: initial letters of ⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ — Greek loanword 'cosmos.'
Editor: Lycopolitan ⲁⲃⲁⲗ ⲙ̄ⲡⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ 'out of the cosmos' — pairs with preceding ⲍⲛ̄ ⲧⲟⲓⲛⲃⲱⲗ 'in the dissolution.'
Editor: definite article required before ⲥⲁⲝⲛⲉ 'counsel.'
Editor: ϥⲁ-ⲉⲁⲍϥ̄ 'he carries him' — verbal prefix; the Great Counsel gathers all into himself alone at the end.
Editor: Greek ἀνδριάς 'statue/image-of-a-man'; lexicon 'Last Andrias / Last Statue' = the complete gathering at consummation, fitting ⲍⲱⲣⲁⲫⲉ 'depiction' in this line.
Editor: ⲉⲡⲉ → ⲉⲡⲉⲓⲇⲏ 'since/because' — Greek conjunction continued onto next line.
Editor: ⲛⲍⲃⲏⲩⲉ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ 'all the works/things' — plural article ⲛⲍ-.
Editor's tentative restoration; ⲭⲁ uncertain, possibly identifying outer aspect parallel to ⲥⲱⲙⲁ. Function = identifier of the Great Counsel's outer manifestation.
Editor: ⲧⲏⲕ ⲁⲣⲉⲧϥ̄ idiom 'stands fast/firm' — the wreath of light stands fast within the Great Counsel.
Editor: completes ⲧⲉⲧϩⲁⲙⲁ[ⲍⲉ ⲛⲍⲏⲧⲥ] 'which-grasps within it' — referring to the wreath.
4-character lacuna following ⲁⲃⲁⲗ; could be ⲛ̄ⲍⲏⲧ or ⲍⲛ̄ ⲧ but unconstrained.
Editor: definite article ⲧ- before fem. ⲛⲁⲟ ⲛⲥⲉⲧⲉ 'great fire' — lexicon: great fire of consummation.
Editor: relative converter ⲧⲉⲧ- before future ⲛⲁⲣⲱⲭⲍ̄ 'which will burn.'
4-character lacuna for the source of the constructions; ⲡⲙⲟⲩ 'death' fits — 'constructions of death' = the self's works that will be consumed at the end. Alternative ⲡⲕⲉⲕⲉ (5 chars) is too long.
7-character lacuna with only ⲩ visible; unconstrained.
Editor: completes ⲡ[ⲱⲛⲍ] 'life' and begins ϩⲁ[ⲟⲱⲣⲟ] 'standing-paired' — pairing of soul with light and life.
Editor: tentative; ⲛⲉⲉⲧϩ likely a participial agentive form continuing the saving/perfecting vocabulary of the Great Counsel section.
Editor: bracketed letter inside ⲟ[ⲩ]ⲁⲛ.
Editor: standard ⲟⲩⲁⲛ ⲛⲓⲙ 'every one' — completed across line break.
5-character lacuna ending in ⲗ; ϫⲉⲕⲁⲗ 'so that' (Lycopolitan ϫⲉⲕⲁⲥ) is a 5-letter conjunction ending in ⲗ — fits 'at the end, so that [they pass] to the great fire.'
Editor: ⲧⲍⲁⲏ ⲛⲛⲉϩⲟⲩⲁⲓ̈ⲯ 'the end of his times' — eschatological idiom; cf. ⲧⲍⲁⲏ in lines 1, 13.
4-character lacuna in defilement clause; unconstrained.
Editor: ⲡⲙⲁⲍⲥⲛⲉⲩ 'the second' — parallel to ⲧⲧⲯⲁⲣⲡ (line 18), ⲧⲧⲙⲁⲍⲯⲁⲙⲧ (line 29), ⲡⲙⲁⲍϩⲧⲁⲩ (line 34).
Editor: completes ⲛ̄ⲟⲉⲣⲏⲟ ⲡⲉ 'counterpart is.'
4-character lacuna naming the entity to which evil counsel is paired; unconstrained.
Editor's tentative; could be ⲟⲩⲁⲓ̈ⲛⲉ 'light' or ⲟⲩⲁⲛⲉ 'manifestation' completed by ⲛⲉ in next slot.
7-character lacuna; second item in the pairing-formula; unconstrained.
Editor: completes directional ⲁⲍⲣⲏⲓ̈ 'upward.'

5-character noun for what is lifted upward; reading says evil counsel 'lifts the substrate of self-love from the depths' to seat it as if it were heaven of heavens. ⲡⲛⲟⲩⲛ 'the deep/abyss' fits exactly (lexicon).
Editor: plural possessive prefix ⲛⲉϩ- 'his' completing ⲛⲉϩⲟⲁⲙ 'his powers' (cf. line 22).
Editor: ⲉⲧⲉⲓⲛⲉ = ⲉⲧ-ⲉⲓⲛⲉ 'while-bringing' (circumstantial of ⲉⲓⲛⲉ).
Editor: article ⲡ- in ⲡⲉϩⲯⲛⲉ 'his soul' — parallel formula across all four counterparts.
8-character lacuna identifying the soul of evil counsel; ends in ⲉ but unconstrained.
Editor: ⲭⲛ̄ 'from'; spatial preposition pairing ⲡⲛⲟⲩⲛ 'Deep' with ⲡⲭⲥⲉ 'Height.'
Editor: ⲁⲡⲭⲥⲉ 'to the Height' — completes the cosmic axis Deep–Height (lexicon).
8-character lacuna preceding -ⲙⲁⲍⲉ 'grasps'; relative/circumstantial verb prefix needed but unconstrained.
3-character continuation of ⲉⲧⲙⲁ from previous section: ⲉⲧⲙⲁ[ⲍⲧⲉ] = ⲉⲧ-ⲁⲙⲁⲍⲧⲉ 'which-seizes/grasps' — desire grasping every power of flesh.
6-character noun; ⲍⲙ̄ ⲡⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ 'in the cosmos' fits the formula — desire grasps in the natural mind toward the souls that live.
7-character lacuna at end of clause about the souls that live; unconstrained.
11-character lacuna ending in ⲙⲁⲩ; could be 'drawing them' formula but unconstrained.
4-character lacuna following ⲉⲧⲭ-; relative clause about bodies but unconstrained.
23-character lacuna preceding 'The fourth'; substantial loss with no traces.
Editor: standard formulaic completion 'the [fourth] counterpart is the spirit of darkness' — parallel to lines 18, 23, 29; the law of Sin and Death follows as identifier.

english_restorations.basis: Coptic ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓ̈ⲛⲉ — the four faces are sent from the Light, the source from which the Lord goes forth toward the soul.
Coptic ⲡⲕⲁⲍ ⲙ̄ⲡⲕⲉⲕⲉ — sea (natural perception in mass) corresponds to the territory of the self-ruled natural mind.
Coptic ⲟⲉⲣϩⲟ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲙⲁⲍ — formula 'The second face is the' continues into 'Third Ambassador' in next section.
Coptic ⲡⲧⲛⲉ — the lower side, the deepest place of the natural mind where the Third Ambassador's image of light is revealed.
Coptic ⲟⲩ ⲉϩⲧⲏⲕ — the light is fixed within the soul's works, awaiting recognition.
Coptic ⲁⲣⲉⲧϩ̄ — completes 'standing among them.'
Coptic ⲡⲉϩⲭⲁⲓ — parallel to section 238's 'his stature of light is the cosmos.'
Coptic ⲧⲏⲣϥ̄ — qualifier on stature; the cosmos is the entire stature of light.
Coptic ⲉⲧⲟⲓ ⲛ̄ⲉⲁⲩ — 'his image which is in glory.'

english_restorations.basis: Coptic ⲡⲡⲣ̄ⲓ̈ⲉ ⲡⲉⲧⲁϩⲉⲓ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ ⲛ̄ⲧⲙⲛⲧ — standard formulaic introduction of Jesus the Radiance, lexicon entry.
Coptic ⲍ ⲉϥⲥⲱⲕ — Jesus sends light and life and draws them upward to the Height.
Coptic ⲧⲏⲣⲥ̄ — 'his entire Wisdom of light.'
Coptic ⲡϣⲏⲛ — souls come to the tree of wisdom; perception/knowledge formed by reception of light.
Coptic ⲛ̄ⲧⲉ ⲡⲛⲁⲃⲉ — 'law of Sin' parallel to 'Error of the cosmos'; cf. section 285's 'law of Sin and Death.'
Coptic ⲉⲩⲣ̄ⲡⲣⲓⲉ — souls become illumined through the Wisdom of light, the goal of Jesus the Radiance's sending.
Coptic ⲁⲣⲁⲩ — directional preposition completing the action of sending.
Coptic ⲁⲃⲁⲗ ⲙ̄ⲡⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ — 'out of the cosmos' in the dissolution at the end.
Coptic ϥⲁ-ⲉⲁⲍϥ̄ — Great Counsel carries all into himself alone at consummation.
Coptic ⲁⲛⲇⲣⲉⲓⲁⲥ — Last Andrias / Last Statue, the complete gathering of all that is the Lord's at the consummation (lexicon).
Coptic ⲡⲉϩⲭⲁ — uncertain reading; possibly identifying the Great Counsel's outer aspect parallel to ⲥⲱⲙⲁ.
Coptic ⲡⲙⲟⲩ — the great fire consumes all constructions of death (the self's dead works).
Coptic ⲡⲱⲛⲍ — soul of Great Counsel paired with light and life present in every work.
Coptic ⲛⲉⲉⲧϩ — uncertain participial form of saving/perfecting vocabulary.
Coptic ϫⲉⲕⲁⲗ — conjunction 'so that' fitting the eschatological 'so that they pass to the great fire prepared.'
Coptic ⲧⲍⲁⲏ ⲛ̄ — 'at the end of his times,' standard eschatological idiom.
Two short lacunae and one tentative letter-cluster ⲛ̄ⲟⲩⲁ; together name the entities to which evil counsel is paired, but unconstrained.
Coptic ⲡⲛⲟⲩⲛ — evil counsel lifts the substrate of self-love from the depths to seat it as if it were heaven (counterfeit ascent).
Coptic ⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ — desire grasps within the natural mind, drawing the souls that live.
Coptic ⲛⲟⲉⲣⲏⲟ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲡ̄ⲛⲁ — formulaic completion: the fourth counterpart is the spirit of darkness, identified as the law of Sin and Death.
